skill.name: knowledge-work-marketing
skill.description: Use when a marketing team needs help with content creation, campaign planning, performance analysis, brand voice consistency, or competitor tracking.
whenToUse: Drafting a blog post, social post, email newsletter, landing page, press release, or case study
Building a full campaign brief with objectives, channels, a content calendar, and success metrics
Reviewing content against your brand voice, style guide, and messaging pillars
Researching competitors or building a marketing performance report with trends and recommendations

keyConcepts.explanation: Content type templates, per-channel writing best practices, SEO fundamentals, headline formulas, and CTA guidance driving the draft-content command.
Campaign frameworks covering channel selection, content calendar creation, budget allocation, and success metrics for a full campaign brief.
Brand voice documentation, voice attributes, tone adaptation, and style-guide/terminology enforcement so drafts stay on-brand.
Competitive research methodology with messaging comparison, content gap analysis, positioning, and battlecard creation.
Key metrics by channel, reporting templates, trend analysis, attribution modeling, and optimization frameworks for marketing performance.
seo-audit runs keyword research, on-page analysis, content gaps, and technical checks; email-sequence designs multi-email nurture, onboarding, and drip flows.

gotchas: brand-review only enforces your voice if a brand style guide is configured in local settings; otherwise it gives a generic clarity review
Configure brand voice, style guide, and personas once so draft-content and brand-review apply standards without re-prompting each time
Best results depend on MCP connections (HubSpot, Amplitude, Ahrefs, Similarweb, etc.); without them performance and competitive data must be supplied manually
The plugin is primarily designed for Cowork though it also runs in Claude Code
